dashboard.description: Plain-language electricity and water trends for curious readers — not the ops HUD. Default range is one week. Solar, hydro, and grid power are compared on one chart (like Grafana dashboard 16053). Re-import from git after edits (npm run grafana:push:citizen).

Live electricity and water from campus meters. Use the time picker above — **default is the last week**.

Solar, hydro, and grid power are on one chart so you can see how each source compares over time.

panels.title: Electricity by source (kW)
panels.description: Instantaneous power from on-site solar, the hydro plant, and the utility grid. All three series share one chart for easy comparison.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(record_ts, $__interval) AS "time", AVG(metric_value) AS value, 'Solar' AS metric
FROM public.utility_measurement_tall
WHERE device_address = 'mb-005'
  AND physical_group = 'solar_field'
  AND metric_key = 'power_instantaneous_A'
  AND unit = 'kW'
  AND $__timeFilter(record_ts)
GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroup(record_ts, $__interval) AS "time", AVG(metric_value) AS value, 'Hydro' AS metric
FROM public.utility_measurement_tall
WHERE device_address = 'mb-005'
  AND source_system = 'hydro_plant'
  AND metric_key LIKE 'power_instantaneous%'
  AND unit = 'kW'
  AND $__timeFilter(record_ts)
GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroup(record_ts, $__interval) AS "time", AVG(metric_value) AS value, 'Grid' AS metric
FROM public.utility_measurement_tall
WHERE device_address = 'mb-001'
  AND physical_group = 'electrical_grid'
  AND metric_key = 'power_instantaneous'
  AND unit = 'kW'
  AND $__timeFilter(record_ts)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Water flow (gallons per minute)
panels.description: Creek intake at the hydro plant, booster pump output, and deep-well pump output — average flow over each time bucket.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(record_ts, $__interval) AS "time", AVG(metric_value) AS value, 'Wyman Creek intake' AS metric
FROM public.utility_measurement_tall
WHERE device_address = 'mb-006'
  AND physical_group = 'hydro_plant'
  AND metric_key = 'flow_wyman_avg'
  AND unit = 'Gpm'
  AND $__timeFilter(record_ts)
GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroup(record_ts, $__interval) AS "time", AVG(metric_value) AS value, 'Booster pump' AS metric
FROM public.utility_measurement_tall
WHERE device_address = 'mb-003'
  AND physical_group = 'booster_pump'
  AND metric_key IN ('flow_avg', 'flow_avg_A')
  AND UPPER(COALESCE(unit, '')) LIKE '%GPM%'
  AND $__timeFilter(record_ts)
GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroup(record_ts, $__interval) AS "time", AVG(metric_value) AS value, 'Deep well pump' AS metric
FROM public.utility_measurement_tall
WHERE device_address = 'mb-008'
  AND physical_group = 'deep_well'
  AND metric_key LIKE 'flow%avg%'
  AND UPPER(COALESCE(unit, '')) LIKE '%GPM%'
  AND $__timeFilter(record_ts)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
